Registering the model only takes model *selection* off the catalog; `resolveBedrockModelId` still consults it, and with #14480 on main the bare `openai.gpt-6-astra` case goes out as `us.openai.gpt-6-astra` in us-east-1. agent feedback: The first three recovery tests cover the feature's main promises well: successful retry, truncation again, and nothing to compact. The tests from here onward mostly protect detailed telemetry behavior for listener errors, hooks, empty responses, and tool-call variants that the run loop already owns. If the telemetry contract is simplified to whether compaction/retry completed, I think these extra cases and much of their supporting implementation can be removed while preserving the important behavioral coverage.
